# gpupaas_bare_metal_skus (Data Source)

List the bare-metal SKUs of a project.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "gpupaas_bare_metal_skus" "all" {
  project = "system-catalog"
}

output "bare_metal_skus" {
  value = data.gpupaas_bare_metal_skus.all.names
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `project` (String) Project to list.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
- `items` (Attributes List) The bare-metal SKUs, sorted by name, with a few identifying fields. Look one up by name for the rest. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--items))
- `names` (List of String) Names of the bare-metal SKUs, sorted.

<a id="nestedatt--items"></a>
### Nested Schema for `items`

Read-Only:

- `description` (String) Description.
- `name` (String) Name.
